parsed.public_post: Good news, villagers: safe bread is back on the shelves today. To thank you for your patience, we’re offering a 10% discount on today’s loaf. Any loaves bought earlier this week can still be exchanged for a full refund or safe replacement. See us at the co‑op for details!
